name: math_majority_v3_group_disjoint
split_policy: all variants of one normalized original_question stay in one split; final eval_samples records are validation
external_test_policy: normalized original questions from MATH test, GSM8K test, and Omni-MATH rule test are blocked from both train and validation
target_mix: about 75% MATH (official train plus 18000 MetaMath-MATH) and 25% MetaMath-GSM8K (8000), matching v2 source counts
notes: Run scripts/prepare_data.py --skip_zh --skip_mix first so converted MetaMathQA rows contain original_question metadata. All variants from one original remain in one split; the cap controls representation count, not split isolation.
